title: Wave-1 legacy Markdown adapter development replay
source_representation: Exact cached wave-1 JATS captures rendered to Markdown with jats-markdown-v1, then checked by the legacy Markdown/text path.
separation_note: These results are not combined with the direct source-native JATS replay. In particular, the old Markdown path could see a denominator layout that the current JATS contract classifies as unsupported.
control_result: No candidates appeared on the five selected controls. They are not certified error-free controls, and this is not a false-positive rate.
limitation: The positive labels were known development material. This replay is a regression comparison between source representations, not independent sensitivity or precision evidence.
